description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, which is a Android Fragment that contains a custom LogView for displaying log messages. It sets up the UI components programmatically, including a ScrollView and LogView, and manages text change events to auto-scroll to the bottom when new log data is added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that hosts a LogView for displaying logs with auto-scroll functionality.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, applying layout parameters, styling, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's method to inflate the view hierarchy, set up a TextWatcher to handle auto-scrolling after text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used in this fragment.
